_doc: HOS-150 AC8 — acknowledged schema drifts. Each entry below is a known
drift that the static checker would otherwise flag. Shrink this list
as follow-up PRs land migrations or align the ORM. Do NOT add new
entries without a Linear ticket number in the `reason` field.

users.reason: Created by fastapi-users at first run; no Supabase migration. Track in HOS-150 follow-up.

pms_sync_logs.reason: ORM-only since Story 2.2; never had a migration. Backfill needed.

captation_baselines.reason: ORM-only since Story 2.4; never had a migration. PR2 (HOS-150 AC6) consumes this table — first user must seed manually until migration lands.

local_events.reason: ORM-only; PredictHQ ingestion table never migrated.

recommendation_cache.reason: ORM-only; legacy table from pre-receipts era.

training_runs.reason: ORM-only; Prophet training metadata. Backfill needed.

restaurant_profiles.reason: Migration 20250203000000 has never been extended despite ORM accreting columns through Phase 0/1. Bidirectional drift — ORM and original migration have diverged. Backfill migration needed.

demand_anomalies.reason: Migration 20260323000000 created richer schema than the ORM model surfaces; ORM uses fewer fields than the DB stores.

fb_patterns.reason: Migration 20260323230000 added `payload JSONB` for Qdrant compat; ORM model never adopted it.

operational_memory.reason: False positive from static parser unioning two migrations. Migration 20260323240000 (current) defines `reflection`; legacy 20260327000000 still has `content NOT NULL` which would fail in a fresh DB anyway. Cleanup tracked in HOS-150 follow-up — drop the duplicate CREATE TABLE in 20260327000000.
